name: scope-path-with-a-number-sign
description: A source path segment holding a number sign is percent-encoded in the reference, because the first number sign of a reference ends its scope: the unexported function nothing calls in src/a#b.ts is reported, and its finding's reference spells the segment a%23b.ts, never a#b.ts, which would read as the scope ./src/a and a fragment. The suppression phase writes that reference into an ignore entry, and the entry binds the finding.
